items.title: AI's next big bottleneck isn't infrastructure. It's regulatory red tape.
items.summary: Resistance to data center development and AI regulation is taking center stage in politics ahead of the midterm elections. Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley joins Market Domination's Josh Lipton to break down the growing demand for industry oversight and which state is seeing a surprise pushback against data center construction.

items.title: ExxonMobil Stock's Biggest Risk Is The Shortage Ending
items.summary: ExxonMobil's refining and chemical margins rest on capacity that is offline elsewhere, which makes a return to normal supply the risk worth weighing.

items.title: Big Oil Is Betting Billions On Nuclear Fusion
items.summary: Eni is making one of Big Oil’s biggest fusion bets, backing Commonwealth Fusion Systems, committing $1+ billion to its future electricity and developing critical tritium fuel-cycle technology.

items.title: Chevron Falls as Oil Surrenders the Iran Premium

items.title: America’s Strategic Petroleum Reserve Is Running on Fumes. What Happens When the Next Supply Shock Hits?
items.summary: The U.S. just used its emergency oil buffer to blunt a major supply shock, and it worked. But the strategy left America's strategic reserve at its lowest point in over four decades, and the next disruption could arrive before a single replacement barrel goes in the ground.
